metadata.title: Webull Launches Crypto Trading In Canada

content.text:
Online trading platform Webull (NASDAQ: $BULL) has begun offering cryptocurrency trading in Canada.
Webull says it is responding to investor demand by offering its Canadian clients access to crypto trading.
Going forward, Webull will provide Canadian investors with access to digital assets in a secure, transparent way given that its trading platform is a regulated financial institution within Canada.
More From Cryptoprowl:
-
Eightco Secures $125 Million Investment From Bitmine And ARK Invest, Shares Surge
-
Stanley Druckenmiller Says Stablecoins Could Reshape Global Finance
Investors that use Webull will be able to fund, monitor, and trade a variety of cryptocurrencies from a single platform.
Cryptocurrencies that Canadians can access via Webull include Bitcoin (CRYPTO: $BTC), Ethereum (CRYPTO: $ETH), Solana (CRYPTO: $SOL), and Cardano (CRYPTO: $ADA), among others.
Webull Canada also said in a news release that its cryptocurrency trading prices will be transparent and competitive with other online platforms.
Competition for crypto trading in Canada is heating up. Earlier this year, Robinhood Markets (NASDAQ: $HOOD) officially entered Canada following its acquisition of WonderFi.
BULL stock has declined 44% in the last 12 months to trade at $6.70 U.S. per share.
